mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (teacher_id, course_name, is_finished, fixed_schedule, class_weekday, class_time, approval_required, max_students, cover_url, show_student_ranking) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{courseName}, #{isFinished}, #{fixedSchedule}, #{classWeekday}, #{classTime}, #{approvalRequired}, #{maxStudents}, #{coverUrl}, #{showStudentRanking})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_personnel p WHERE p.course_id=c.course_id) member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_application a WHERE a.course_id=c.course_id AND a.status='PENDING') pending_applications FROM course c WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.course_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND is_finished = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET is_finished = #{isFinished} WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
